rawQuotes.text: 请继续下一步C8，之后的切片方案

goal: Intake can extract text from PDF, Word, and image attachments, and analysis can use an LLM extractor to turn raw ideas into candidate requirements that still need human approval
scenarios: a PDF attachment is stored as a source document and its text is extracted into chunks
a Word document attachment is stored and its text is extracted
an image can be understood or OCR'd into extracted text, or stay pending with a parse error when understanding is missing
analysis extracts goals, actors, scenarios, constraints, risks, assumptions, open questions, and acceptance
LLM analysis can add Bug candidates while still producing Epic, Feature, Story, Task, and Research nodes
every candidate keeps source references where possible
human approval is still required before candidates become WorkItems
LLM analysis fails loud when no extractor is configured instead of silently writing WorkItems
constraints: candidates are not committed WorkItems until approved
Phase D work is planned only, not started
